# Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) — template (WP10)

The remediation plan, resourced and dated. A POA&M differs from a risk register
in one important way: the register says what is wrong, the POA&M commits to
**who does what by when**.

| POA&M ID | Finding ID | Weakness | Remediation | Resources required | Owner | Milestone(s) | Scheduled completion | Status | Change record |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P-001 | | | | | | | | Ongoing / Completed / Delayed | CHG-xxxx-xxxx |

**Rules:**

- **Ordered by the priority you argued for in WP14**, not by finding ID and not
  by severity alone. If your ordering does not match your budget argument, one of
  the two is wrong.
- **Resources are real** — hours, a maintenance window, a licence, someone else's
  approval. "N/A" is almost never true.
- **Every completed row cites its change record.** That link is what makes the
  work auditable, and it is how an assessor confirms you did what you claimed.
- **Delayed is an acceptable status**, with a reason and a new date. Silently
  slipping a date is not.
